name: unifi-toolkit
description: A comprehensive suite of tools for UniFi network management and monitoring.

paths.name: Data Dir
paths.description: IMPORTANT: Create this directory on the host first with correct permissions: # chown 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/unifi-toolkit

variables.name: Encryption Key
variables.description: Encryption key for securing UniFi credentials stored in the database

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Database URL (default uses SQLite in data/ directory)

variables.name: Type of deployement
variables.description: Deployment type: local or production - local: No authentication, access via http://localhost:8000 - production: Authentication required, HTTPS via Caddy

variables.name: Stalker Refresh Interval
variables.description: Wi-Fi Stalker: Device refresh interval in seconds
